custodyCases.name: deposits build the basis, a sale realizes it, a swap moves it, a withdrawal takes its share
the class A position cap: 15% of the basis passes, one unit over does not
the class A total cap: 50% of the basis across four positions, one unit over refused
a wrong attested price widens nothing: high, the basis caps the position; low, the capped value shrinks trades
a class A token counts at its attested price, then at zero a day later, and the breaker trips
flows across many tokens never move the value per unit
the 12% trade and 45% value backstops at their thresholds
a screened token is unbuyable until the owner opts in, and opting out is instant
selling a token entirely removes it and its basis; a slow fill is refused at 1%
a drawdown nobody poked refuses new risk, and a sale records it
